literature.role: VRE can increase or decrease electricity price volatility depending on regional flexibility and wind/solar profiles.

literature.role: U.S. ISO evidence on nonlinear VRE penetration and electricity-price volatility.

literature.role: Fuel mix and marginal generation matter for real-time electricity price volatility; wind intensity changes the channel.

lookahead_policy.formal_forecast: HAR uses log_rv lag1/week/month plus renewable_share_mean.shift(1); OOS train rows end strictly before forecast date.
lookahead_policy.same_day_diagnostics: High-renewable same-day contrasts are descriptive only, not the PASS gate.

gate.pass_rule: Publication-strength PASS is disabled for this NP15-only pilot. A multi-hub rerun would require QLIKE improvement with DM t<-3 plus positive HAC t>3 lagged renewable-share coefficients across multiple hubs.
